PERFUMERS' QUOTES Tropicalia is an ultra-high impact ingredient with great diffusion. It evokes a memory of tropical environment, particularly the juicy tropical fruits. It has facets of a hint of a mint & white flower, quite unique in olfaction. Milind Davare, Vice President Perfumer "Tropicalia is a unique, outspoken ingredient that will push the performance and _ bring a new dimension to your creations." Elise Pajot, Perfumer Tropicalia is a fruity cocktail that can be used in floral-fruity compositions. It has a well-balanced blend of tropical mango, peach, and guava notes with a touch of apple sweetness. It has the power to enhance fruity and citrus notes. Jui B Kokate, Junior Technical Perfumer
